sources.entry: Spectrum 2 - Spectrum 2 is an open source instant messaging transport. It allows users to chat together even when they are using different IM networks. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 C++

summary.one_liner: Spectrum 2 is an open source instant messaging transport that lets users chat with each other even when they are on different IM networks.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Spectrum 2 as an instant messaging transport that acts as a layer between users, allowing people on different IM networks to chat together. The README given is very short and does not list specific protocols, setup steps, or configuration details. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a custom communication system, and the metadata gives C++ as the language and GPL-3.0 as the license.
use_cases: let users on different IM services talk together
notable: Acts as a transport layer so users on different instant messaging networks can chat together
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under custom communication systems
Written in C++ and licensed under GPL-3.0
caveats: README is very brief and gives no installation, configuration, or protocol details
Specific supported IM networks are not named in the provided README
keywords: talk to friends on other chat apps
